title: Dereth Town Tour - Timaru scratch

shots.standingOrder: Rise from 6 m over the river in the western gorge up the sunlit cliff until the palisaded Aun village of Timaru appears on its plateau.
shots.notes: ESTABLISHING + WATER (drone.rising-reveal). Starts 6 m over the river in the western gorge (z 26), facing the gorge wall; rises 114 m in 16 s and eases 20 m east until the palisade, the gate tower and the 24 m Aun totem frames of Timaru appear on their 120 m plateau above the 90 m Marescent plateau; ends at z 146 pitched -8. Afternoon sun (west, 63 deg) behind the camera lights cliff and palisade. Verified offline (real registry build + WBT terrain): start (5523.0,35076.0,32.0) end (5543.0,35076.0,146.0), min AGL 6.0 m, nearest static/building/tree 23.8 m (0x02000A37@5538,35057), peak 11.4 m/s; WBT get-height at 5 path samples matched the checker terrain to 0.00 m.

shots.standingOrder: Look straight down 30 m over the Aun stone circle with its smouldering brazier while the image turns slowly and drifts toward the great hut.
shots.notes: FLAME (drone.top-down). Nadir 30 m above the Aun stone circle (eight standing stones) with the smouldering brazier at its centre, rotating 75 deg and drifting 6 m east toward the great hut whose chimney smoke (0x02000B33) leans in the wind; torches ring the clearing, the octagonal palisade frames the edges. Verified offline (real registry build + WBT terrain): start (5713.3,35075.8,150.0) end (5719.3,35075.8,150.0), min AGL 30.0 m, nearest static/building/tree 16.7 m (0x1DB6#96 0x010021D9), peak 0.6 m/s; WBT get-height at 5 path samples matched the checker terrain to 0.00 m.

shots.standingOrder: Hold wide south of the great waterfall below Timaru with a slow drift and push, the weir bridge and falling sheets of water filling the frame.
shots.notes: WATER (classic.establishing). Wide static with a slow 10 deg drift and 8 % push, 95 m south of the great waterfall and 22 m above the lower pool: the 120 m wide cascade with its stone piers and weir bridge, eight spout sheets (0x0200085A) plunging 26 m into the mist curtain (0x020003C5); afternoon sun from the right rakes across the spray. shots.standingOrder: Race south along the river above the weir bridge, crest the falls and dive through the spray to pull out 3 m over the pool below.
shots.notes: SPECTACLE + WATER (fpv.fpv-dive, FPV preset; JEV-eligible). Level run at z 47 along the river, 6.6 m over the weir deck (top 40.4), crest the falls and dive at -78 deg through the falling water and mist, pulling out 3 m over the lower pool and racing 30 m south. Peak 15.7 m/s. shots.standingOrder: Dolly back from the great Aun head statue with its red glowing eyes and torch-lit mouth while zooming in so it holds size and the cliffs swell behind it.
shots.notes: LANDMARK + FLAME (classic.dolly-zoom). The giant Aun head statue at the cliff foot (0x010026FC, 21 m; it houses the Marescent Plateau Portal) with red glowing eyes (0x020006A0) and torches flanking its mouth: camera 12 m up SSW dollies back 27 m while zooming 60 -> 28 deg, the head holding its size as the plateau cliffs behind swell - vertigo.
